text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Début 2021, le CASO a été réorganisé pour devenir un Safety Office", "gist": "CASO was reorganized into a Safety Office in early 2021"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "les activités se concentrent sur une surveillance systémique qui concerne dorénavant tous les offices du DETEC", "gist": "the activities now focus on systemic safety monitoring across all DETEC offices"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Cela signifie que le DETEC veille à garantir une sécurité coordonnée et systématique dans tous les offices", "gist": "This means DETEC ensures coordinated and systematic safety across all its offices"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Cependant chaque office continue d’être responsable de la surveillance de la sécurité dans son propre domaine", "gist": "However, each office remains responsible for safety monitoring in its own area"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "La surveillance systémique de la sécurité au DETEC augmente la résilience", "gist": "Systemic safety monitoring at DETEC increases resilience"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Toutes les unités administratives du département sont en mesure de faire face à des incidents externes ou internes", "gist": "All departmental administrative units can handle external or internal incidents"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Elles savent tirer profit des effets positifs et compenser les influences négatives", "gist": "They know how to leverage positive effects and offset negative influences"}]}
